license_required.quote: Any person, firm, partnership, corporation, or other entity who practices dentistry in this state without obtaining a license to practice from the board shall be guilty of a felony

issuing_authority.quote: A board to be known as the Georgia Board of Dentistry is created.

name.quote: A board to be known as the Georgia Board of Dentistry is created.

type.quote: the board shall not be under the jurisdiction of the Secretary of State but shall be a division of the Department of Community Health

umbrella_agency.quote: the board shall not be under the jurisdiction of the Secretary of State but shall be a division of the Department of Community Health

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Surgery (D.D.S.) or Doctor of Dental Medicine (D.M.D.) from an accredited dental school
degree_required.quote: Applicants for a license to practice dentistry must have received a doctor of dental surgery (D.D.S.) degree or a doctor of dental medicine (D.M.D.) degree from a dental school approved by the board and accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA)
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency

degree_level.quote: must have received a doctor of dental surgery (D.D.S.) degree or a doctor of dental medicine (D.M.D.) degree

school_approval_basis.quote: accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency

credential_pegged.quote: Applicants for a license to practice dentistry must have received a doctor of dental surgery (D.D.S.) degree or a doctor of dental medicine (D.M.D.) degree from a dental school approved by the board and accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency

required.quote: Applicants for a license to practice dentistry must have received a doctor of dental surgery (D.D.S.) degree or a doctor of dental medicine (D.M.D.) degree from a dental school approved by the board and accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency, if any.

experience_source.quote: Applicants for a license to practice dentistry must have received a doctor of dental surgery (D.D.S.) degree or a doctor of dental medicine (D.M.D.) degree from a dental school approved by the board and accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency

exams.name: Clinical examination
exams.quote: all applicants must pass a clinical examination approved by the board

exams.name: Jurisprudence examination
exams.notes: On laws of Georgia and rules and regulations relating to the practice of dentistry; administered in English
exams.quote: a jurisprudence examination on the laws of this state and rules and regulations as they relate to the practice of dentistry as established or approved by the board, which shall be administered in the English language

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed by the board to practice dentistry shall register biennially on the renewal date set by the board

required.quote: The board shall be authorized to require persons seeking renewal of a dental license under this chapter to complete board approved continuing education of not less than 40 hours biennially.

hours_per_period.quote: complete board approved continuing education of not less than 40 hours biennially

period_years.quote: complete board approved continuing education of not less than 40 hours biennially

value: legal ethics and professionalism in the practice of dentistry
unprofessional conduct relating to sexual intimacy, abuse, misconduct, or exploitation
legislative updates and changes to laws relating to dentistry
topical_requirements.quote: On and after January 1, 2022, continuing education requirements for dentists shall include legal ethics and professionalism in the practice of dentistry, which shall include, but shall not be limited to, education and training regarding professional boundaries; unprofessional conduct relating to the commission of acts of sexual intimacy, abuse, misconduct, or exploitation with regard to the practice of dentistry; legislative updates and changes to the laws relating to the practice of dentistry and rules, policies, and advisory opinions and rulings issued by the board; professional conduct and ethics; proper billing practices; professional liability; and risk management.

available.quote: Applicants for a provisional license to practice dentistry by credentials must have received a doctor of dental surgery (D.D.S.) degree or a doctor of dental medicine (D.M.D.) degree from a dental school approved by the board and accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency, if any. Applicants must have been in full-time clinical practice ... and must hold an active dental license in good standing from another state.

requirements.value: Provisional license by credentials requires DDS or DMD from CODA-accredited school, five years full-time clinical practice, active dental license in good standing from another state, passing a board-approved clinical examination and jurisprudence examination.
requirements.quote: Applicants must have been in full-time clinical practice, as defined by rules and regulations established by the board; full-time faculty, as defined by board rule and regulation; or a combination of both for the five years immediately preceding the date of the application and must hold an active dental license in good standing from another state.

exists.quote: A board to be known as the Georgia Board of Dentistry is created. The board shall consist of 17 members to be appointed and commissioned by the Governor

national_association.quote: accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA) or its successor agency

regulatory_model.quote: Any person, firm, partnership, corporation, or other entity who practices dentistry in this state without obtaining a license to practice from the board shall be guilty of a felony

credential_type.quote: Any person, firm, partnership, corporation, or other entity who practices dentistry in this state without obtaining a license to practice from the board shall be guilty of a felony

is_mandatory.quote: Any person, firm, partnership, corporation, or other entity who practices dentistry in this state without obtaining a license to practice from the board shall be guilty of a felony

title_protection.quote: By any means whatsoever makes it known, implies, or holds out to the public in any fashion that such person will do any of the operations, procedures, or services set forth in this subsection.

scope_protection.quote: Any person, firm, partnership, corporation, or other entity who practices dentistry in this state without obtaining a license to practice from the board shall be guilty of a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license contained in this chapter or in the rules and regulations issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of dentistry or in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of dentistry or on any document connected therewith; or practiced fraud or deceit or intentionally made any false statement in obtaining a license to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of any felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude in the courts of this state or any other state, territory, or country or in the courts of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Arrested, charged, and sentenced for a felony or moral turpitude crime with nolo contendere plea, first offender treatment, or withheld adjudication
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been arrested, charged, and sentenced for the commission of any felony, or any crime involving moral turpitude, where: A plea of nolo contendere was entered to the charge

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license revoked, suspended, or annulled by any other lawful licensing dental authority or was denied a license pursuant to disciplinary proceedings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his or her license to practice dentistry revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing dental authority other than the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct harmful to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public, which conduct or practice materially affects the fitness of the licensee or applicant to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in the practice of dentistry as an employee of an unlicensed individual or impermissible corporate entity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in the practice of dentistry as an employee of any individual not licensed to practice dentistry in this state or engaged in the practice of dentistry as an officer or employee of any corporation other than one organized and existing pursuant to Chapter 10 of Title 14

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aided, assisted, or encouraged any unlicensed person or suspended/revoked licensee to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performed any act which in any way aids, assists, procures, advises, or encourages any unlicensed person or any licensee whose license has been suspended or revoked by the board to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a statute, law, or rule relating to the practice of dentistry, or violated a lawful board order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a statute, law, or any rule or regulation of this state, any other state, the board, the United States, or any other lawful authority (without regard to whether the violation is criminally punishable), which statute, law, or rule or regulation relates to or in part regulates the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction within or outside this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Displayed an inability to practice dentistry with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, alcohol, drugs, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Displayed an inability to practice dentistry with reasonable skill and safety to patients or has become unable to practice dentistry with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in excessive prescribing or administering of drugs, or prescribed controlled substances without a legitimate dental purpose
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in the excessive prescribing or administering of drugs or treatment or the use of diagnostic procedures which are detrimental to the patient as determined by the customary practice and standards of the local community of licensees; or knowingly prescribed controlled drug substances or any other medication without a legitimate dental purpose

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive statements in advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made any fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive statement in any form of advertising or made any statement in any advertisement concerning the quality of the dental services rendered by that dentist or any dentist associated with him or her.

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, or any combination thereof, whether using surgical or nonsurgical procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions, or any combination thereof, of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, or the adjacent and associated structures, or any combination thereof, and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, or any combination thereof, whether using surgical or nonsurgical procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions, or any combination thereof, of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, or the adjacent and associated structures, or any combination thereof, and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law

value: dental operations on oral cavity, teeth, gingiva, alveolar process, maxilla, mandible
physical evaluation prior to dental services
methods_authorized.quote: Operates or performs part of any dental operation of any kind upon the human oral cavity, teeth, gingiva, alveolar process, maxilla, mandible or associated structures, or associated contiguous masticatory structures for the treatment of diseases or lesions of such structures

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe and administer drugs including controlled substances for legitimate dental purposes; may administer conscious sedation and general anesthesia with board-issued permits
drug_authority.quote: No dentist licensed and practicing in the State of Georgia shall administer either single or multiple pharmacologic agents by oral, parenteral, enteral, transdermal, or transmucosal route that renders a patient to a state of conscious sedation as defined in Code Section 43-11-1, unless such dentist has been issued a permit by the board

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: No dentist licensed and practicing in the State of Georgia shall administer either single or multiple pharmacologic agents by oral, parenteral, enteral, transdermal, or transmucosal route that renders a patient to a state of conscious sedation as defined in Code Section 43-11-1, unless such dentist has been issued a permit by the board

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The board or its appointed designee may, upon reasonable notice, make on-site inspections of the facility, equipment, and personnel of a dentist issued a permit under this Code section to determine if the standards of paragraph (2) of subsection (b) of this Code section are being maintained.

specialist_license_available.quote: The board is authorized to provide by rule or regulation for definitions of the several dental specialties.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means that a licensed dentist is in the dental office or treatment facility, personally diagnoses the condition to be treated, personally authorizes the procedure and remains in the dental office or treatment facility while the procedure is being performed by the dental hygienist, and before dismissal of the patient, examines the patient. "General supervision" means that a licensed dentist has authorized the delegable duties of a licensed dental hygienist but does not require that a licensed dentist be present when such duties are performed.

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A licensed dentist may only authorize up to four licensed dental hygienists to provide dental hygiene services pursuant to subsection (g), (h), or (i) of this Code section at any one time.

value: students in Title I schools and schools with 65% or more students eligible for free or reduced price lunch
patients in federally qualified health centers
patients in health facilities operated by federal, state, county, or local governments
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: In school settings, licensed dental hygienists may apply topical fluoride and perform the application of sealants and oral prophylaxis under general supervision... In hospitals, nursing homes, long-term care facilities, rural health clinics, federally qualified health centers, health facilities operated by federal, state, county, or local governments, hospices, family violence shelters... and free health clinics, licensed dental hygienists may apply topical fluoride and perform the application of sealants and oral prophylaxis under general supervision.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: engaged in the practice of dentistry as an employee, manager, or member of any limited liability company organized and existing pursuant to Chapter 11 of Title 14 or a limited liability partnership pursuant to Chapter 8 of Title 14 other than one in which all members are licensed dentists and all professional services and professional judgment decisions are delivered by and made by licensed dentists

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: A dental assistant or licensed dental hygienist assisting a licensed dentist during the lawful administration of conscious sedation under Code Section 43-11-21 or general anesthesia under Code Section 43-11-21.1 shall complete board approved training on the applicable procedures, protocols, patient monitoring techniques, equipment, and any other safety related topics required by the board.
